Available Personalized Stories

Personalized Story

We design a complete story with your child as its hero: their photo inside the artwork, their name in the telling, and the world or character they love. Printed to a high standard so it stays a keepsake, not a book read once.

From $20 / copy

What we’ll need from you

  • Child’s ageRequired Age shapes the length and style of the story, and affects the price. 1–5 years — $206–12 years — $25
  • Child’s nameRequired Exactly as you’d like it to appear.
  • Child’s photoRequired A clear, well-lit photo with the face visible gives the best result.
  • Favourite character or worldRequired Tell us what they love: a princess, space, football, a cartoon character…
  • Additional notesOptional Anything else you’d like us to know (optional).
We use your child’s photo only to prepare your order, and never for marketing without your permission.
Production usually takes 2–5 days
That’s the time to make and prepare your order. Delivery time is separate and is arranged with you based on your location.
